_meta.purpose: The D6 Sentinel feed list (ATLAS_FRAMEWORK_REVIEW.md Section 9.3, D6, a CLOSED decision: CoinDesk, an ASX and a US index feed, RSS news, node telemetry; nothing more. Fix round 3 removed a fifth source, a Yahoo Finance BTC-USD price series, that D6 does not name). Read by the orchestrator's Sentinel task (path handed over as SENTINEL_FEEDS in /etc/atlas/orchestrator.env); installed by phase2/08-sentinel.sh, which also proves every host is in config/allowlist.txt and probes each URL once.
_meta.verification: No feed URL below is VERIFIED by the research (services-tools.md / platform.md never fetched them; config/allowlist.txt marks the Sentinel group UNVERIFIED). Every URL is the conventional free endpoint of that publisher and is marked verified=false. Rule for the task (adjudicated for this file): a feed that is unreachable or unparsable is logged as 'feed unreachable: <id>' in the Sentinel log and the pulse continues; it is never a pulse failure. Once a feed has been seen working on the node, the task may record verified_on_node in its own state; this file stays as written.
_meta.allowlist: Every host here MUST appear in config/allowlist.txt (Sentinel group). phase2/08-sentinel.sh dies when one is missing and warns about a Sentinel-group entry no feed uses. Hosts used: www.coindesk.com, query1.finance.yahoo.com and query2.finance.yahoo.com (asx200 and sp500 respectively; both listed by name), stooq.com, feeds.bbci.co.uk, www.abc.net.au, www.theguardian.com. Allowlisted but used by no feed: .asx.com.au (the allowlist writer should remove it).
_meta.schema: feeds[]: id, kind (rss|json|csv), url, fallback_url (optional), owner (persona key), hemisphere (corporate|estate: the owner's division, Section 6.2; Alaric is Estate, Silas Corporate), topic, series (for json/csv: how to read the number), thresholds (statistics-first detection, Section 9.3), verified (bool), note. telemetry[]: id, source (paths under /proc and /sys, a command the atlas worker can run, or a root-exported file; container names are the container_name values of docker/core/compose.yml and compose.voice.yml, all atlas- prefixed except wg-easy: atlas-redis, atlas-chromadb, atlas-openwebui, atlas-kokoro, atlas-speaches, atlas-docling, atlas-ntfy), thresholds. Every source is readable by the executor, the cpu worker running as atlas (groups render, video, docker; no journal or squid log group): restic, journalctl and squid's log are therefore never named as sources. detection: the rule text. alert: BLUF entry + ntfy push.
_meta.detection_rule: Section 9.3: statistics first. Each pulse stores the reading; deviations are computed against the last 24 readings (hourly) and the thresholds below; a model (the resident router model or Eleanor's engine) is invoked only when a threshold trips, and escalates to a large engine only on anomaly. Never swaps an engine out from under an active session: the Engine Arbiter queues it (4.2 rule 6).
_meta.poll: hourly (atlas-sentinel.timer); the task must finish inside the hour; per-feed HTTP timeout 20 s; every request through the allowlist proxy (HTTPS_PROXY from /etc/atlas/proxy.env).

systemctl show atlas-aegis.service -p ExecMainStartTimestamp -p Result -p ExecMainStatus (readable by atlas; restic itself needs root): age of the last backup run, whether it succeeded, and restic's exit code. ExecMainStatus=3 with Result=success is a PARTIAL snapshot ('some source files could not be read', SuccessExitStatus=3 in the unit): report it as a warning reading, never as healthy (fix round 3)

/var/lib/atlas/telemetry/firewall.json (FIREWALL_TELEMETRY_FILE in orchestrator.env), written as root by /usr/local/sbin/atlas-sentinel-telemetry from atlas-sentinel.service's ExecStartPre=-+ before each enqueue (phase2/atlas-sentinel-telemetry.sh): last-hour counts of '[UFW BLOCK]' and '[ATLAS docker egress denied]' kernel log lines and squid TCP_DENIED lines; keys ts, window_s, ufw_block, docker_egress_denied, squid_denied, denied_per_hour, errors (a null count = could not count). Stale (ts older than 2 h) or missing = 'telemetry unreadable: firewall', never zero
